comment: docs/notes2: every build loses a roughly fixed 40-80 accelerator cycles per k step and memory tile (int4 PE 64x64 512x4096: 73 of 512 -> 87.5 %; PE 32x64 512x2048: 41 of 512 -> 92.7 %; float PE 32x8 went from 93.2 to 96.3 % when its tile doubled). Doubling the work per k step (tile_n/PN * tile_m/PM = 1024) should recover about half of that. Tiles 1024x4096 (PE 64x64) and 1024x2048 (PE 32x64): tile_m/PM = PN, powers of two, twice the per-PE C buffer. Same clocks and presets as the best builds of int4_pe64 and int4_clock. DDR read taps tuned under load.
